videos.title: Navi Pillay wins Nobel as US hits ICC with sweeping sanctions | Reuters World News
videos.description:
The US says it will livestream the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood shooter. The Trump administration sanctions the International Criminal Court hours after a former ICC judge wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. ICE defends its officers after a shooting in New York City. And Russia says there is no risk of an epidemic breaking out after the death of a worker at a plague research lab in Siberia.

videos.title: LIVE: Housing activists in Barcelona protest in tribute to Maricarmen Abascal
videos.description:
Housing activists in Barcelona stage a protest in tribute to Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked housing protests in Spain. Abascal died this week, Madrid's tenants' union said, and news of her passing sparked a renewed wave of demonstrations demanding action on the housing crisis.
